sn46.44:1.1: kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami ||la-pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Duppañño eḷamūgo duppañño eḷamūgo ti bhante vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho bhante Duppañño eḷamūgo ti vuccatī ti || || Sattannaṃ kho bhikkhu bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā duppañño eḷamūgo ti vuccati || || Katamesaṃ sattannaṃ
